List each field with its observed load/store before drafting the structure. Keep observed opaque byte-array extents fixed across ABIs; native pointer growth should move subsequent host fields, not shrink the unknown data to preserve obsolete host offsets. A representation migration must inventory matching setter APIs as well as getters and query consumers, using original call sites when source callers are still copied.
